sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Older learners and online courses
passage.text: Online courses were expected to be a gift for older learners, who often find it hard to travel to a campus. Participation tells a different story. Adults over sixty enroll in large numbers but complete far fewer courses than younger students. The reasons are practical rather than attitudinal: platforms assume users can navigate menus, upload files and join video calls, and a single confusing step can end the attempt. A pilot programme that paired each learner with a student helper for the first two weeks raised completion sharply. The technology was not the barrier; learning the technology alone was.

sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

answer.text: 技术本身并不是障碍；真正的障碍在于要独自学会使用这项技术。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: many older adults sign up for online courses but few finish them. Suggest how platforms or universities could help.

answer.text: Older adults are not short of motivation: they enroll in online courses in large numbers. What they lack is support in the first hours, when a confusing menu or a failed upload can end the attempt. Universities could therefore offer a short induction, either in person or by phone, in which a student helper sits beside the learner and completes one real task together. Platforms could simplify registration and keep a telephone line open during the first week. Neither measure is expensive, and both attack the real barrier, which is learning the technology alone rather than learning the subject. Completion, not enrolment, is the number that matters.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：把原因归为「老年人不愿学」或「课程太难」，与原文 attitudinal / content 无关的判断相反。
